name: PriorityLevel
title: Priority Level
publisher: HL7 US Realm Program Management Steward
purpose:
(Clinical Focus: Concepts representing priority classifications used to indicate the urgency or sequence in which healthcare activities, services, or cases should be addressed.),(Data Element Scope: Concepts from the SNOMED CT qualifier value hierarchy that categorize the relative priority of healthcare activities, including normal, high, and delayed priority.),(Inclusion Criteria: SNOMED CT qualifier value concepts specifically denoting general priority levels:
394848005 | Normal priority |
394849002 | High priority |
441808003 | Delayed priority |),(Exclusion Criteria: only concepts identified; excludes scheduled - priority and other priority-related concepts outside of the three specified general categories, including numeric triage scores, workflow-specific priorities, and domain-specific urgency classifications.)
